title: BCC Ruling No. 09-03-1215 — retirement-home egress through shared public area
code_edition: Ontario Building Code 2006, O. Reg. 350/06 (as cited)

For ground-floor suites, one proposed path to an exit passed through a public corridor and a shared area containing resident dining.
The cited provisions are Sentences 3.3.1.3.(9) and 3.3.1.4.(1) of Division B.
